records.statement:
theorem cos_eq_one_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, cos (θ s) = 1
records.proof:
by
  have hi : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) = ℓ := by
    unfold xCoord at hx
    linarith
  intro s hs
  by_contra hne
  have hp : cos (θ s) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (cos_le_one _) hne
  have hlt := intervalIntegral.integral_lt_integral_of_continuousOn_of_le_of_exists_lt
    hℓ (continuous_cos.comp hθ).continuousOn continuousOn_const
    (fun t _ => cos_le_one (θ t)) ⟨s, hs, hp⟩
  have : (∫ t in 0..ℓ, cos (θ t)) < ℓ := by simpa using hlt
  linarith
records.comment:
Saturation of the horizontal displacement bound forces the horizontal
tangent component to be one, including at the endpoints.

records.statement:
theorem sin_eq_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, sin (θ s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  have hc := cos_eq_one_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ hx s hs
  have hh := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ s)
  rw [hc] at hh
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sin (θ s))]
records.comment: The vertical tangent component vanishes under the same saturated constraint.

records.statement:
theorem curvature_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, curvature θ s = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hc := cos_eq_one_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ.continuous hx
  have hs := sin_eq_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ.continuous hx
  have hd : EqOn (deriv θ) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (Ioo 0 ℓ) := by
    intro s hsi
    have he : (fun t => sin (θ t)) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hsi] with t ht
      exact hs t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩
    have hh := ((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.sin).deriv
    rw [he.deriv_eq, deriv_const, hc s ⟨hsi.1.le, hsi.2.le⟩, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  have hclosed := hd.closure hθ.continuous_deriv_one continuous_const
  simpa only [curvature, closure_Ioo hℓ.ne, Set.EqOn] using hclosed
records.comment: For C¹ angles, the signed curvature also vanishes on the closed interval.

records.statement:
theorem angle_eq_initial_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0
records.proof:
by
  apply angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial (θ := fun _ => θ 0) hℓ contDiff_const hθ
  · intro s hs
    simpa using curvature_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ hx s ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
  · rfl
records.comment:
Fixing the initial real angle removes the possible multiples of 2π:
the whole lifted angle is exactly its initial value.

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_straight_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ = ℓ * ε 0
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  have he : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)) = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε 0 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le hℓ.le] at hs
    exact congrArg ε (curvature_zero_of_xCoord_eq_length hℓ hθ hx s hs)
  rw [he]
  simp
records.comment:
Every exactly feasible curve for the saturated horizontal displacement has
the same energy, for any density; no sign assumption on its second derivative.

records.statement:
theorem straight_is_global_minimum_on_horizontal_constraint {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hx : xCoord θ 0 ℓ = ℓ) :
    energy ε (fun _ => 0) ℓ ≤ energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_const, energy_eq_straight_of_xCoord_eq_length
    (x₀ := 0) hℓ hθ (by simpa using hx)]
records.comment:
In particular the straight curve is a global minimizer among all C¹ angles
with the saturated horizontal displacement, for every density. Adding the
fixed vertical endpoint and fixed end angles only restricts this feasible set.

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_hasDerivAt (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u * (1 - u) * (u - 1 / 2))
      (-3 * s ^ 2 + 3 * s - 1 / 2) s
records.proof:
by
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id s).mul ((hasDerivAt_const s (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id s))).mul
    ((hasDerivAt_id s).sub_const (1 / 2))) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; ring)
records.comment: Derivative of the explicit fixed-end polynomial variation.

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_integral :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd (s : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -(u ^ 4) / 4 + u ^ 3 / 2 - u ^ 2 / 4)
        (s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) s := by
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 4).neg.div_const 4).add
      (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 3).div_const 2)).sub
        (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 2).div_const 4) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; norm_num; ring)
  have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) := by fun_prop
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h
records.comment:
Its average is zero, hence it lies in the vertical linearized constraint
kernel at a horizontal straight curve.

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_deriv_square_integral :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      (deriv (fun u : ℝ => u * (1 - u) * (u - 1 / 2)) s) ^ 2) = 1 / 20
records.proof:
by
  have hd (s : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => 9 * u ^ 5 / 5 - 9 * u ^ 4 / 2 +
        4 * u ^ 3 - 3 * u ^ 2 / 2 + u / 4)
        ((-3 * s ^ 2 + 3 * s - 1 / 2) ^ 2) s := by
    convert ((((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 5).const_mul 9).div_const 5).sub
      ((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 4).const_mul 9).div_const 2)).add
        (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 3).const_mul 4)).sub
          ((((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 2).const_mul 3).div_const 2) |>.add
            ((hasDerivAt_id s).div_const 4) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; norm_num; ring)
  have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (-3 * s ^ 2 + 3 * s - 1 / 2) ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  simp_rw [(straight_polynomial_hasDerivAt _).deriv]
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h
records.comment: Its derivative has strictly positive squared integral, evaluated exactly.

records.statement:
theorem negative_quadratic_second_deriv (q : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 2) / 2)) q = -1
records.proof:
by
  have hd : deriv (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 2) / 2) = fun x => -x := by
    funext x
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -(u ^ 2) / 2) (-x) x := by
      convert ((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).neg.div_const 2 using 1
      all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [id_eq]; norm_num; ring)
    exact h.deriv
  rw [hd]
  exact (hasDerivAt_id q).neg.deriv

records.statement:
theorem straight_polynomial_variation_not_exactly_feasible {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    xCoord (angleVariation (fun _ => 0)
      (fun s : ℝ => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) t) 0 1 < 1
records.proof:
by
  let θ : ℝ → ℝ := angleVariation (fun _ => 0)
    (fun s : ℝ => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)) t
  have hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := by
    change ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s : ℝ => 0 + t * (s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)))
    fun_prop
  have hne : xCoord θ 0 1 ≠ 1 := by
    intro hx
    have ha := angle_eq_initial_of_xCoord_eq_length (ℓ := 1) (x₀ := 0)
      (by norm_num) hθ (by simpa using hx) (1 / 4) (by constructor <;> norm_num)
    norm_num [θ, angleVariation] at ha
    exact ht (by linarith)
  have habs := abs_x_displacement_le θ 0 1 (by norm_num)
  have hle : xCoord θ 0 1 ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using (le_abs_self (xCoord θ 0 1)).trans (by simpa using habs)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
records.comment:
Although its first endpoint derivative is zero, every nonzero member of
this additive variation has strictly smaller horizontal displacement.

records.statement:
theorem straight_negative_secondVariation_counterexample :
    (∀ θ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 θ → xCoord θ 0 1 = 1 →
      energy (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2) (fun _ => 0) 1 ≤
        energy (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2) θ 1) ∧
    ∃ η : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ η 0 = 0 ∧ η 1 = 0 ∧
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..1, cos (t * η s)) 0 = 0 ∧
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..1, sin (t * η s)) 0 = 0 ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun t =>
        energy (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2)
          (angleVariation (fun _ => 0) η t) 1)) 0 = -1 / 20
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun θ hθ hx => straight_is_global_minimum_on_horizontal_constraint
    (by norm_num) _ θ hθ hx, ?_⟩
  let η : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => s * (1 - s) * (s - 1 / 2)
  have hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η := by dsimp [η]; fun_prop
  refine ⟨η, hη, by simp [η], by simp [η], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [zero_add, sin_zero, neg_zero, zero_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_zero] using
      (hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation (θ := fun _ => 0)
        (ℓ := 1) (by norm_num) continuous_const hη.continuous).deriv
  · have h := (hasDerivAt_vertical_variation (θ := fun _ => 0)
      (ℓ := 1) (by norm_num) continuous_const hη.continuous).deriv
    simpa only [zero_add, cos_zero, one_mul, η, straight_polynomial_integral] using h
  · rw [secondVariation_energy (by norm_num)
      (show ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun q : ℝ => -(q ^ 2) / 2) by fun_prop) contDiff_const hη]
    simp_rw [negative_quadratic_second_deriv]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hi : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (deriv η s) ^ 2) = 1 / 20 :=
      straight_polynomial_deriv_square_integral
    rw [hi]
    norm_num
records.comment:
The straight curve is an exact constrained global minimizer, but this C¹
fixed-end direction belongs to both linearized endpoint kernels and has a
negative actual energy second derivative. The singular constraint is essential.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_angleVariation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (hη : Differentiable ℝ η) (t s : ℝ) :
    deriv (angleVariation θ η t) s = deriv θ s + t * deriv η s
records.proof:
by
  exact ((hθ s).hasDerivAt.add ((hη s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).deriv
records.comment: Its curvature is the sum of the original curvature and the varied derivative.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_variation {ε κ v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hv : Continuous v) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (κ s) * v s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hεd : Differentiable ℝ ε := hε.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hε' : Continuous (deriv ε) := hε.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv ε (κ p.2 + p.1 * v p.2) * v p.2) :=
    (hε'.comp ((hκ.comp continuous_snd).add
      (continuous_fst.mul (hv.comp continuous_snd)))).mul (hv.comp continuous_snd)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)).prod
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
  have hmeas (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => ε (κ s + t * v s)) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    (hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hint : Integrable (fun s => ε (κ s + (0 : ℝ) * v s))
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) := by
    exact ((hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ).1
  have hmeas' : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => deriv ε (κ s + (0 : ℝ) * v s) * v s)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    ((hε'.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hv).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    intro t ht
    exact hC (t, s) ⟨⟨le_of_lt ht.1, le_of_lt ht.2⟩, ⟨le_of_lt hs.1, hs.2⟩⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ), ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun t => ε (κ s + t * v s))
        (deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s) t := by
    filter_upwards [] with s
    intro t _
    convert (hεd (κ s + t * v s)).hasDerivAt.comp t
      (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (v s)).const_add (κ s)) using 1
    all_goals first | (funext x; rfl) | ring
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmeas) hint hmeas' hbound
    (integrable_const C) hdiff
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ, zero_mul, add_zero] using h.2
records.comment:
Differentiating a general density under a finite curvature integral.

The compact rectangle supplies the bound; boundedness of the density derivative
on all of ℝ is not assumed.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_variation hℓ hε
    (hθ.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)) (hη.continuous_deriv (by norm_num))
  simpa only [energy, deriv_angleVariation
    (hθ.differentiable (by norm_num)) (hη.differentiable (by norm_num))] using h
records.comment: First variation of the energy evaluated at the genuinely varied angle.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_horizontal_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, Real.cos (θ s + t * η s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -Real.sin (θ s) * η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [Real.deriv_cos] using
    (hasDerivAt_integral_variation hℓ Real.contDiff_cos hθ hη)
records.comment: First variation of the horizontal displacement.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_vertical_variation {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, Real.sin (θ s + t * η s))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, Real.cos (θ s) * η s) 0
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [Real.deriv_sin] using
    (hasDerivAt_integral_variation hℓ Real.contDiff_sin hθ hη)
records.comment: First variation of the vertical displacement.

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_zero_exponentialWeight (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    powerLog 0 (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) = -β * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [powerLog_zero, log_exponentialWeight]
records.comment: At exponent zero, the composed representation recovers the energy exactly.

records.statement:
theorem tendsto_powerLog_exponentialWeight_zero (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun p => powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)) (𝓝 0)
      (𝓝 (-β * energy ε θ ℓ))
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [log_exponentialWeight] using
    tendsto_powerLog_exponent_zero (exponentialWeight_pos β ε θ ℓ)
records.comment:
The positive weight makes the existing exponent-zero limit applicable to
every energy value, regardless of the sign of the curvature or the density.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog_exp_neg_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x d : ℝ}
    (p β : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => powerLog p (exp (-β * f t)))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * f x) * d) x
records.proof:
by
  have he : exp (-β * f x) ^ (p - 1) * exp (-β * f x) =
      exp (-p * β * f x) := by
    rw [rpow_def_of_pos (exp_pos _), log_exp, ← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  convert (hasDerivAt_powerLog (p := p) (exp_pos (-β * f x))).comp x
    (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf) using 1
  · rfl
  · calc
      -β * exp (-p * β * f x) * d =
          -β * (exp (-β * f x) ^ (p - 1) * exp (-β * f x)) * d := by rw [he]
      _ = _ := by ring
records.comment: Chain the two already proved derivatives and simplify the positive factor.

records.statement:
theorem strictAnti_powerLog_exp_neg_mul (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    StrictAnti (fun x : ℝ => powerLog p (exp (-β * x)))
records.proof:
by
  apply strictAnti_of_deriv_neg
  intro x
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => powerLog p (exp (-β * t)))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * x) * 1) x := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using hasDerivAt_powerLog_exp_neg_mul p β (hasDerivAt_id x)
  rw [hd.deriv]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos hβ) (exp_pos _)
records.comment: All real response exponents reverse energy order when β is positive.

records.statement:
theorem energy_le_iff_powerLog_exponentialWeight_le (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ) ≤
        powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  exact (strictAnti_powerLog_exp_neg_mul p hβ).le_iff_ge.symm
records.comment:
Exact comparison on the same curves, with no regularity requirement for
this order-theoretic identity.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_iff_powerLog_weight_local_maximum (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
          |ψ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv ψ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
        powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ) ≤
          powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  simp only [LocallyMinimizing, energy_le_iff_powerLog_exponentialWeight_le p hβ]
records.comment:
Compose with the existing constrained C¹ neighborhood, retaining all
endpoint data rather than replacing it by an unconstrained scalar problem.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog_weight_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (p β : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => powerLog p
      (exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * energy ε θ ℓ) *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by
    funext s
    simp only [angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simpa only [exponentialWeight, hzero] using
    hasDerivAt_powerLog_exp_neg_mul p β (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη)
records.comment: Actual differentiation along the existing angle variation.

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_weight_variation_stationary_iff {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (p : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => powerLog p
      (exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)) 0 = 0 ↔
      deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 = 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_powerLog_weight_variation hℓ hε hθ hη p β).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη).deriv]
  simp only [mul_eq_zero, neg_eq_zero, hβ, exp_ne_zero, false_or]
records.comment: Vanishing of the actual first variation is unchanged for every exponent.

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_exponentialWeight_split {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (p β a ℓ : ℝ) :
    powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) =
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) +
      powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))) +
      p * powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) *
        powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s))))
records.proof:
by
  rw [exponentialWeight_split hε hθ β a ℓ]
  exact powerLog_mul p (exponentialWeight_pos β ε θ a) (exp_pos _)
records.comment:
Interval composition transports through the already established product
identity for normalized powers; p=0 reduces to additive negative energy.
